10.2.5 PduRRoutingPathGroup
[ECUC_PduR_00308] Definition of EcucParamConfContainerDef PduRRouting
PathGroup ⌈
Container Name
PduRRoutingPathGroup
Parent Container
PduRRoutingPaths
Description
This container groups routing paths. By this grouping, it is possible to switch all
routings related to one network, or to one kind of PDUs. PduRRoutingPaths link one
source with one destination. Enabling and disabling of routing path groups is done
using the PduR API.
